usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all Active Directory (LDAP) authentication realms configured in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. Requires the Realm.Allocate privilege on /access/domains — typically held by administrators only. Call this before creating or updating AD realm settings to confirm existing realm names and server configuration.
tips: The 'realm' field in each returned object is the identifier used when logging in as user@realm.
Check the 'default' field to see which realm is pre-selected on the PDM login screen.
The 'mode' field indicates LDAP transport security: prefer 'ldaps' or 'ldap+starttls' over plain 'ldap' in production.
If 'verify' is false, TLS certificate validation is disabled for the AD server connection — a potential security risk worth flagging during audits.
bind-dn and base-dn being absent from a realm entry means user sync is not fully configured for that realm.
